decisive_items: a 104 × 102 × 141 mm mediastino-pulmonary mass in the left upper lobe
an endobronchial lesion in the left upper-lobe bronchus
response.rationale: The large left upper-lobe mass with vascular encasement and an endobronchial lesion strongly favor primary lung cancer, especially with rapid ipsilateral pleural reaccumulation. Lymphoma is less specific and metastatic disease lacks a primary or multifocal pattern.

rejected.why: Mediastinal mass and pleural effusion can occur in lymphoma, but the endobronchial lesion and pulmonary parenchymal mass with vascular encasement are more characteristic of lung cancer.
No primary malignancy or multifocal metastases are described; a solitary lung mass with endobronchial involvement and ipsilateral effusion favors a primary lung neoplasm.
